items.titleEn: Proof: The famine in Sudan is a rumor!
items.summaryEn: Proof: The famine in Sudan is a rumor! Dr. Murtaza Ghali said: "There is no famine in Sudan... and talking about famine is rumor and media war meant to affect the morale of the citizens". The Secretary-General of the United Nations for Foreign Affairs...
